title: NV-Tesseract-AD: Curriculum-Enhanced Conditional Diffusion for Multivariate Time-Series Anomaly Detection
abstract: arXiv:2610.12754v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We propose NV-Tesseract-AD, a curriculum learning-enhanced conditional diffusion framework for multivariate time-series anomaly detection. Our central hypothesis is that reconstruction difficulty can be explicitly structured along two complementary axes, masking severity and diffusion noise level, and that training from easier to harder tasks along both axes simultaneously stabilizes optimization and improves residual discriminability. We integrate a Transformer-based diffusion backbone with a three-stage dual curriculum over masking ratios and diffusion timesteps, retaining anomalous samples throughout training and relying on structured corruption to drive self-supervised representation learning. We evaluate NV-Tesseract-AD under two regimes: in-distribution training on the TSB-UAD-M corpus and strict zero-shot transfer to ten EasyTSAD benchmark families without per-dataset tuning. translated_title: NV-Tesseract-AD：面向多元时间序列异常检测的课程增强条件扩散模型
translated_abstract: 我们提出了NV-Tesseract-AD，一个用于多元时间序列异常检测的课程学习增强的条件扩散框架。我们的核心假设是：重建难度可以沿着两个互补的轴（掩码严重程度和扩散噪声水平）进行显式结构化，并且同时沿这两个轴从易到难进行训练，可以稳定优化过程并提高残差的可辨别性。我们将基于Transformer的扩散骨干网络与覆盖掩码比例和扩散时间步的三阶段双课程学习相结合，在整个训练过程中保留异常样本，并依靠结构化破坏来驱动自监督表示学习。我们在两种设置下评估NV-Tesseract-AD：在TSB-UAD-M语料库上进行分布内训练，以及在不进行每个数据集调优的情况下，严格零样本迁移到十个EasyTSAD基准数据族。双轴课程产生了掩码不变的重建（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出NV-Tesseract-AD框架，通过在掩码严重程度与扩散噪声水平两个互补轴上同时实施由易到难的三阶段双课程学习，增强了基于Transformer的条件扩散模型在多元时间序列异常检测中的优化稳定性与残差判别能力，并实现了无需逐数据集调优的严格零样本迁移。
en_tdlr: NV-Tesseract-AD enhances Transformer-based conditional diffusion for multivariate time-series anomaly detection through a three-stage dual curriculum over masking severity and diffusion noise level, simultaneously improving optimization stability and residual discriminability while enabling strict zero-shot transfer without per-dataset tuning.
